subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/engineering/diagnosing-bugs#phase1-completion-criterion
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-20 (conversation), deferred review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3, accepting the report's reject recommendation. Opposite stance: upstream forbids any hypothesis until one command, already run once, drives the bug path and can go red on the user's symptom, gives the same verdict every run (for a flaky bug, a pinned high reproduction rate), runs in seconds and is agent-runnable, with a person in the loop only through its script. Ours forms provisional hypotheses from code and evidence from the start, continues safe source analysis or instrumentation when no reproduction is available, can confirm a cause without one by independent evidence such as traces, and otherwise reports it provisional with any proposed fix unproven (.claude/skills/systematic-debugging/SKILL.md:24-27; .claude/skills/systematic-debugging/SKILL.md:36-41; .claude/skills/systematic-debugging/SKILL.md:59-62).

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/engineering/diagnosing-bugs#fixed-hypothesis-count
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-20 (conversation), deferred review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3, accepting the report's reject recommendation. Opposite stance: ours chooses a discriminating observation instead of generating a fixed count of hypotheses; a three-to-five quota is an invented numerical threshold, which the writing principles prune (.claude/skills/systematic-debugging/SKILL.md:26-27; .claude/skills/authoring-for-agents/references/writing-principles.md:35-36).

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/engineering/diagnosing-bugs#hypothesis-ranking-presentation
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-20 (conversation), deferred review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3, accepting the report's reject recommendation. Ours requires each provisional hypothesis to state what result would confirm or refute it and has no checkpoint that presents hypotheses to the user; upstream asks for a non-blocking showing of the ranked list before testing. AGENTS.md has routine details decided independently and reserves questions for material ambiguity, and the owner declined adding a presentation step to this routine part of the diagnosis (U-02) (.claude/skills/systematic-debugging/SKILL.md:24-27; AGENTS.md:9-10).

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/engineering/diagnosing-bugs#debugger-first
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-20 (conversation), deferred review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3, accepting the report's reject recommendation. Ours probes the suspected boundary or variable one change at a time with tagged probes, and for a multi-component chain instruments each boundary once and reads where the chain breaks; it names no tool preference, so a fixed debugger-first order is an absolute rule for a context-dependent choice (S-08) (.claude/skills/systematic-debugging/SKILL.md:28-32; .claude/skills/systematic-debugging/references/localization.md:31-42).

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/engineering/diagnosing-bugs#delete-debug-prototypes
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-20 (conversation), deferred review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3, accepting the report's reject recommendation. Ours sets cleanup on its own terms: before answering, systematic-debugging removes the temporary instrumentation it added, keeps useful reproducers and user artifacts and lists the reproducers kept and any instrumentation left, leaving instrumentation in place when the caller says its own closeout removes it; the bug-fix playbook's closeout then removes the tagged instrumentation and keeps reproducers and user artifacts. Neither forbids discarding a separate throwaway prototype; the owner declined a separate gate that deletes or quarantines prototypes before declaring done (.claude/skills/systematic-debugging/SKILL.md:67-68; .claude/skills/systematic-debugging/SKILL.md:72-74; .claude/skills/mvp-mode/playbooks/bug-fix.md:86-87).

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/engineering/diagnosing-bugs#escalate-unreproducible
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-20 (conversation), deferred review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3, accepting the report's reject recommendation. Opposite stance: when no loop can be built, upstream stops, lists what was tried and asks for access, an artifact or instrumentation rather than hypothesise. Ours continues safe source analysis or instrumentation: the cause can be confirmed by independent evidence such as traces, stay provisional with the evidence that would tell the remaining hypotheses apart requested, or be unresolved when it is environmental or external (.claude/skills/systematic-debugging/SKILL.md:36-41; .claude/skills/systematic-debugging/SKILL.md:54-65).

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/engineering/diagnosing-bugs#justified-phase-skip
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-20 (conversation), deferred review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3, accepting the report's reject recommendation. Ours puts skip rules where steps are skipped: the bug-fix playbook skips diagnosis only on a stated observable condition (a deterministic failing command whose output points at the cause), mvp-mode keeps a playbook step that will not run in the list with its reason, and systematic-debugging's own steps scale to the evidence (minimise only enough, probe only while new evidence comes) rather than being skipped; a separate justification rule for skipping diagnosis phases repeats those owners (S-05) (.claude/skills/mvp-mode/playbooks/bug-fix.md:48-52; .claude/skills/mvp-mode/SKILL.md:48; .claude/skills/systematic-debugging/SKILL.md:17; .claude/skills/systematic-debugging/SKILL.md:28-30).
